**Remarks (follow-up on 15 May 2024):** This finding remains open. The 11 leaning posts between check post 3 and the Kodaikanal road junction have not been attended to as of today. No further deterioration was noted since the 14 May visit, but the soil around the base of posts 214 and 217 has softened further after the light rain on the night of 14 May.

**Action taken so far:**
